name: korenmarkt
frequency_note: 28 and 39 GHz sit inside the ITU-R P.2040-4 validity band of every material this scene uses. 60 GHz does not: brick and asphalt_concrete are tabulated only to 40 GHz, and PowerLawMaterial.evaluate raises rather than extrapolate silently. 60 GHz is therefore listed separately as an explicit opt-in. A caller that wants it has to pass allow_extrapolation=True and carry the consequences into the result: applicability becomes indicative_extrapolation and the uncertainty multiplier becomes 1.585, from the 0.585 octaves between 40 and 60 GHz. Substituting concrete for brick was rejected because it would hide the gap behind a material the facades are not made of.

geometry_selection.coverage_acceptance: At least 99% of the previous 200 m projection in each validation view

geometry_note: Standalone ENU support mesh. Inhouse triangulation supplies first-hit depth only. Semantic boundary resolution comes from the source image pixels.
